title: Spiriti! Napoli '97
subtitle: Unofficial Ghostbusters-inspired tribute game set in Naples, 1997
acknowledgements: A tribute to the paranormal-comedy arcade tradition of 1984
Naples landmarks drawn for the game; Villa Doria d'Angri from a photograph
Original soundtrack; no film, television or game theme is quoted
content_notice: TRIBUTE GAME - unofficial and unaffiliated. Ghostbusters is referenced only to identify the work being paid tribute to. Code, artwork, music and effects are original; no franchise logo, character art, dialogue, soundtrack or game asset is included.

controls.action: Choose a district; brake / accelerate; move the trap, the hunter or the car
Start, dispatch the Fiat, fire the proton beam
Back, give the job up; in the piazza, open the roof trap

start_prompt: Press A to start the night shift
